index.title: Club administration
index.releasedHint: These clubs are visible via a club release – read-only access, no editing possible.
index.deleteConfirmContent: Should this club really be permanently deleted? This action cannot be undone.

edit.title: Club administration
edit.name: Name
edit.shortNameHint: Maximum 4 characters, e.g. for the livestream.
edit.stateAssociationHint: The state federation determines which competition administers the club.
edit.contactEmailHint: This address receives: the match report scan reminder, game day checklist confirmations and objections, published and changed referee assignments, and all transfer and player release messages. Please enter exactly one address.
edit.notifyManagersHint: All club managers receive the same messages as the contact email. Uncheck anyone who should not. Newly appointed club managers are included automatically.
edit.notifyManagersEmpty: No club manager is assigned to this club.
edit.teamManagersManagePlayers: Team managers may create, deactivate and reactivate players
edit.teamManagersManagePlayersHint: Without this option these three actions stay with the club manager. They govern the club roster: creating a player admits a person to the club, deactivating keeps their profile out of the club player list and out of the licence request selection. Team managers can field players and request licences regardless. For a syndicate the option applies to the teams of every participating club.
edit.logoUploadAfterSave: Logo can only be uploaded after saving
edit.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP · square (width = height) · max. 3 MB · resized to 100×100 pixels
edit.logoTransparencyHint: Ideally upload a cut-out image, i.e. a PNG with a transparent background. The logo will also appear on dark backgrounds, for example in livestream overlays, where a white box is clearly visible.
edit.deactivateConfirmText: The club will be removed from the active club list. The record is retained and can be reactivated.

notifications.logoTypeError: Only PNG, JPG or WebP allowed.
notifications.nameRequired: A club name must be set
notifications.longNameRequired: A club name (from the register) must be set
notifications.shortNameTooLong: The abbreviation must not exceed 4 characters
notifications.contactEmailInvalid: The contact email must be exactly one valid address
